title: Planck-Units-Based Consciousness Field \( \Phi_{C^n} \) and Wave Function Collapse Beyond Penrose OR
content: Planck units represent the fundamental scale at which physics, biology, and consciousness converge. This article develops the model in which time-invariant superfluid quantum space is the primary physical reality, composed of Planck quanta. Duration and past-future are emergent, not fundamental. Gravity is derived as a pushing effect of the variable energy density of this space, not as spacetime curvature. We introduce consciousness as a fundamental, non-created physical field, denoted \( \Phi_{C^n} \), composed of complex Planck quanta and characterized by Planck frequency. The wave function is not consciousness itself, but its mathematical description. This distinction provides a physical mechanism for the measurement problem that the Copenhagen interpretation lacks. In this model, wave function collapse occurs because the excitation of superfluid quantum space receives a coherent energy kick from the consciousness field \( \Phi_{C^n} \). This energy transfer promotes a virtual bio-photon to a real bio-photon with defined spin, enabling binary information transmission in brain microtubules. Gravity plays no role in quantum superposition. The consciousness field \( \Phi_{C^n} \) and the coherent bio-photon field play a decisive role, mediating coupling between consciousness and biological matter.
